subject: Re: Saffron status: replication green, honest limits
body:
Team,

Saffron scope decision for the Q3 pitch, agreed with Jelena:

We pitch offline trajectory augmentation for the robotics prototyping group — generating and extending candidate trajectories in batch, where seconds-per-action latency does not matter and context limits are manageable. We explicitly do not pitch online control; Yusuf's numbers make that case honestly and I want credibility with the robotics leads.

Emeka's service prototype narrows to the batch API accordingly. Maren, the eval harness should report extrapolation quality against held-out trajectories — that is the pitch's proof point.

Pitch is May 20, 25 minutes with Hana. Draft to this thread by May 15.

Priya
